fieldNotes.site: Houston A-B brewery (opened 1966) at 775 Gellhorn Dr. Large brewery building with adjacent very large trailer drop yard to the east, bounded by I-610 on the east and Gellhorn Dr on the south.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Perimeter fully fenced (wrought-iron and chain-link) confirmed in multiple Street Views. Brewery building has sliding gates in the fence line at its west entrance. Controlled access to the secured site - truckGate TRUE.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth observed at the trailer-yard entrance off Gellhorn Dr (wide open driveway with only a stop sign) nor a distinct booth at the brewery building gates in Street View. Classified guardShack FALSE, remoteGs TRUE - flagged uncertain since a booth may be obscured.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Very large organized trailer drop yard east of the brewery, ~200+ trailers in rows; capacity ~320.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long dock bank along the south face of the brewery building with trailers backed in; estimated 35 doors (band 25-50).
fieldNotes.railServed: Rail spurs run into the property between the brewery and the trailer yard.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide trailer-yard entrance apron with ample paved width to add lanes.
fieldNotes.scale: No truck scale resolved in imagery.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~724 x 1015 m covers brewery core plus trailer yard ~181 acres.
